title: micromeria notarisii
intro: Micromeria notarisii, commonly known as Greek mountain tea, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria notarisii include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
